meta.description: Live intelligence on Division of Lumination operations, schemes, and movements.

entries.activity: Order of the Sun patrols in Solvetra have doubled since the Lumina Lab explosion — squads of four are stopping residents without cause, demanding proof of employment and district registration.
Lantern agents have been seen photographing building facades in the Solvetra Intermellum, likely mapping the district's layout ahead of a planned enforcement sweep.

The DOL is circulating a new pamphlet titled 'The Light Endures' — a rewritten account of the Tre Illium founding that omits Kaela Shadowsong entirely and reframes Sibling Thorne as the sole architect of civilisation.

OOTS officers have been stationed at every major road into Ars Lapis, checking carts for contraband — the checkpoints are ostensibly about gem smuggling, but agents are also confiscating lunar-symbol jewellery.

The Lorewarden Emeritus has issued a formal retraction of three historical texts held in Ars Cultura's public archive, ordering them pulped. Scholars have been given forty-eight hours to surrender personal copies.
A new DOL recruitment drive is underway in Ars Pontaris — recruitment tables staffed by NSPF representatives, offering signing bonuses and 'service to the eternal light' as incentive.

Lumina Elixir distribution to Ars Lapis has been placed on hold following the lab's destruction. DOL couriers are being rerouted through Ars Pontaris, where a secondary stockpile is rumoured to exist.
Lantern agents have begun conducting night interviews with tavern owners in Solvetra — asking for names of regulars who speak poorly of the DOL or ask about 'old stories'.

The DOL has announced a public 'Illumination Festival' in Solvetra's central square next tenday — mandatory attendance for registered citizens, lanterns distributed, compliance monitored by OOTS observers on rooftops.
A team of NSPF soldiers under Aurevon Beitomy Erstua has departed Solvetra heading north — their destination is unknown, but supply manifests suggest a weeks-long expedition.
Solvetra Vault has increased its security rotation — guards now change every two hours instead of six, and a new secondary checkpoint has been installed at the inner vault entrance.
DOL scribes at the Lumina Lab site are cataloguing the wreckage. Any documents recovered intact are being sealed and transported directly to the Solvetra Vault under OOTS escort.
The Lorewarden Emeritus has been seen meeting privately with a senior OOTS commander three nights running at a private residence in Solvetra's administrative quarter.

Lantern agents are distributing new household registration forms in the Intermellum — residents must list all occupants, visitors, and 'known associates'. Non-compliance results in district access revocation.
DOL propaganda murals depicting the sun sigil are being painted over old lunar iconography throughout Solvetra — stonemasons contracted under guard, working through the night.
A DOL inquisitor has arrived in Ars Cultura with a list of lecturers to be 'reassigned' — those who have taught on pre-Illumination history or lunar ideology are the primary targets.
OOTS units have been seen conducting drills in a sealed courtyard near the Solvetra Vault — the exercises focus on crowd suppression and building-clearing, not standard patrol rotations.
The DOL is quietly purchasing property in Lunarthorn through a shell merchant — no announcement has been made, but locals are receiving unsolicited buy-out offers for their homes.
A new DOL-aligned solar priest has arrived in Ars Pontaris and begun preaching on the bridge market — his sermons include pointed warnings about 'those who court shadow'.
Lantern agents have been distributing a wanted illustration across Solvetra — the face partially matches descriptions of Corwin Duskwatch. The bounty listed is for 'seditious conspiracy'.
DOL couriers have been making weekly trips to Mount Mortifera escorted by OOTS — no official explanation given, but cargo manifests list 'archival materials for disposition'.

The NSPF has begun training exercises near the Palegleam forest border — officially 'threat assessment drills', but locals in Lunarthorn report the soldiers are asking questions about the forest's interior.

A DOL censor has embedded with Ars Cultura's public library staff — all requests for historical texts older than two hundred years now require written justification submitted to the Lorewarden's office.
Lantern agents tipped off OOTS to a suspected Shadowbringer safehouse in Solvetra — the location was raided and found empty, but the DOL is now watching the surrounding streets.

The DOL is funding a new stage production in Ars Pontaris — a dramatic retelling of the Tre Illium founding that glorifies Sibling Thorne and portrays the drow lineage as villains vanquished by divine light.
OOTS have begun random searches of river barges docking at Ars Pontaris — ostensibly checking for untaxed goods, but passengers with lunar-marked belongings are being detained for questioning.
The Lorewarden Emeritus has requested access to the Echo Veins research logs held in Ars Cultura — scholars who handed them over report the Lorewarden looked troubled by something in the documents.

DOL administrators in Ars Lapis have frozen the gem export licences of three independent mining families — no cause given, but all three families were recently seen associating with non-DOL merchants from Virelle.
A lantern agent known to operate in the Intermellum has gone missing — the DOL has not announced it, but OOTS patrols near Smuggler's Den have increased noticeably in the past three days.

The DOL has quietly commissioned a new alchemical research team to resume Lumina Elixir production at an undisclosed location — requisition orders for Worg containment materials have been traced to a supplier in Ars Lapis.
